message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942‑1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army (commanded by General Georgy Zhukov, with key figures such as Marshal Vasily Chuikov and Colonel General Andrey Vlasov).
• **Nazi Germany** – Wehrmacht’s 6th Army (initially under General Friedrich Paulus, later commanded by General Hermann Hoth).
• **Axis allies** – Italian, Romanian, Hungarian, and German auxiliary units supported the German effort. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now **Volgograd**) in southern Russia, situated on the **Volga River**. The battle took place in and around the urban center, with fighting extending into the surrounding countryside and the Volga’s strategic crossings. | The battle is widely regarded as one of the turning points of World War II, marking the first major defeat of the German army and the beginning of a sustained Soviet counter‑offensive that would eventually push the Germans back to Berlin.
